Name: Wrath
Description: You enter a violent frenzy, flailing in all directions to repeatedly strike nearby foes.

Name: Battle Cry
Description: Increase damage and healing for 2 minutes.

Name: War Cry
Description: Increase the group's damage and healing for 2 minutes. Replaces Battle Cry.

Name: Whirlwind
Description: Damage enemies around user. Replaces Wrath.

Name: Battle Frenzy
Description: Heal when hit for a short time. Pure Only.

Name: Fury
Description: Warrior channels their inner fury, increasing attack damage while sacrificing health.

Name: Inferno
Description: Your temperature rises and burns enemies around you. Replaces Whirlwind. Pure Only.
